facts.text: The image is a multi-panel creature reference sheet with a wide hero panel at the top, three turnaround views in the middle row, and four detail close-ups in the bottom row.
The depicted creature is a large black-scaled dragon with long pale swept-back horns, a spiked crest and dorsal ridge, large leathery bat-like wings, a long spined tail, and clawed limbs.

In the top hero panel, the dragon stands crouched with its head lowered and wings raised over wet reflective ground in a dark rocky volcanic landscape with mist, scattered embers, and distant lava glow.
The panel labeled FRONT shows the dragon facing forward with both wings spread and its body centered against a plain dark background.
The panel labeled SIDE PROFILE shows the dragon in a crouched profile facing left, with its long tail extending to the right and wings held above its back.
The panel labeled REAR shows the dragon from behind with wings spread, revealing the spined back, tail, and hind limbs.
The panel labeled HEAD CLOSE is a close crop of the dragon’s head showing overlapping dark scales, multiple pale horns and spikes, and a small amber-yellow eye.
The panel labeled WING MEMBRANE shows a close view of a dark, thin leathery wing membrane stretched across pale bone-like struts, with a slightly ragged trailing edge.
The panel labeled CLAW AND FOOT shows a close view of a scaly dragon foot with several large curved dark claws.
The panel labeled SCALE DETAIL shows tightly overlapping dark scales with blue-teal iridescent highlights.

card.summary: A dark fantasy creature reference sheet presenting a single black-scaled dragon across a cinematic hero view, front/side/rear turnaround panels, and close-up studies of its head, wing membrane, foot, and scales.
